verdict.rationale: Bolt's first-party docs describe inviting collaborators at any stage, assigning them access roles, and a real-time multiplayer mode where people prompt and edit the same project at the same time. GitHub sync with branches adds another way for a team to work on one project. The main caveat is that multiplayer mode is documented only for projects whose visibility is set to public. Missing for 10: real-time multiplayer for private projects, details of a team-level shared workspace beyond per-project invites, and independent or hands-on corroboration of multiplayer working in practice.
